patterns_found.name: Double Top
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct peaks near 66000 are visible on the chart, separated by a significant decline. Price is currently retesting the intermediate low area around 64500-64800 after failing at the 66000 resistance zone again.

patterns_found.evidence: Prior bullish structure from the 62000 low up to 66000 is showing signs of deterioration. Recent price action is making lower highs and is breaking below recent swing lows around 64800-65000.

patterns_found.name: Bearish Flag
